_doc: RI-033 — Parallel content block indices (HI-C5-001). Two text blocks start in parallel (index 0 + index 1), deltas arrive INTERLEAVED across indices (delta@1 'second' before delta@0 'first'), and blocks stop in start-order (0 then 1). The XLI BlockTracker (HashMap<index, BlockState>) must route each delta to the correct block by index. OutputItemDone is emitted on each content_block_stop in stop-arrival order, so the final ResponseItem[] is [Message('first'), Message('second')] — pi sees the same.
